title: German Banana Omelette
description: A classic German twist on the traditional omelette, incorporating bananas for a sweet and savory treat.
instructions: 1. In a bowl, whisk together eggs, sugar, and cinnamon until well combined.
2. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add melted butter.
3. Pour in the egg mixture and cook until the edges start to set.
4. Add sliced bananas to one half of the omelette.
5. Use a spatula to gently fold the other half of the omelette over the bananas.
6. Cook for another minute and slide the omelette onto a plate.
7. Serve hot with whipped cream if desired.
